name: Conrad Manila
insider_take: Where Manila's golden sunsets meet world-class luxury in the heart of the Philippines' most dynamic district.
whats_special: Conrad Manila stands as the tallest hotel in the Philippines at 31 stories, offering breathtaking Manila Bay sunset views from every room. Located in the prestigious Mall of Asia Complex, it's the country's first and only Conrad property, featuring the largest pillarless ballroom in Southeast Asia and direct access to one of the world's largest shopping centers.
pro_tip: Book a bay view room on floors 20+ for the most spectacular Manila Bay sunsets - locals consider these among the world's most beautiful, and the hotel's floor-to-ceiling windows provide unobstructed views.
dont_miss: The rooftop infinity pool with panoramic city and bay views, China Blue restaurant's modern Cantonese cuisine, and the nearby Cultural Center of the Philippines complex. Take advantage of the complimentary shuttle to Rizal Park and explore Intramuros, Manila's historic walled city, just 15 minutes away.
pros: Prime location in Manila's business district with easy access to shopping and dining
Exceptional service standards and luxury amenities typical of Conrad brand
Modern accommodations with premium facilities and city views
Multiple dining options and comprehensive business facilities
cons: Urban location may have limited outdoor recreational spaces
